result.brief: 提出 DAG 约束的世界模型 CaLA，从预处理历史推断变分潜表征以消除自适应策略下的混淆，提升想象 rollout 的因果干预估计可靠性。
result.reason: Proposes a DAG-constrained world model with variational latent representation inferred from history for causal intervention estimation under adaptive policies; directly a world-model representation contribution.
